title: Nice Sweet Malaysian Toffee Popcorn Bowl
description: A sweet and aerated post-workout Malaysian dish featuring toffee popcorn, this vegan-friendly bowl is perfect for a snack or dessert. It combines the crunch of popcorn with the sweetness of toffee and the freshness of Malaysian flavors.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the air-popped popcorn, toffee bits, coconut sugar, and sesame seeds.
In a small saucepan, heat the maple syrup over low heat until it is warm and runny.
Pour the warm maple syrup over the popcorn mixture and stir until everything is well coated.
Sprinkle the shredded coconut, pandan extract, and sea salt over the top of the popcorn mixture and stir again.
Transfer the popcorn mixture to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and spread it out in a single layer.
Place the baking sheet under the broiler and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the top is lightly toasted.
Remove the baking sheet from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Transfer the toasted popcorn mixture to a serving bowl and serve immediately.
